name: Math Animation
tagline: A math or science idea goes in, a calm animated explainer in the style of 3Blue1Brown comes out.
description: A narrated video where equations morph, graphs draw themselves and shapes rearrange until the idea clicks. It's for teachers, students and anyone explaining something technical. What makes it good: one clear insight, shown as a picture before the formula, with the voice paced to every move.
bring: The idea you want to explain: a proof, a formula, a concept
Optional: notes, a textbook page or a script
get: A 1–5 min 16:9 animated explainer at 1080p60 with narration
steps: Find the one idea the video should make click
Plan the picture that proves it and review it as a storyboard
Write the narration and make the voice
Animate each scene, paced to the voice
Join the scenes and add the voice and music
Review each version in FrameJam until it's right
